generationInputs.prompt: A digitally created image features a central illustration of two stylized hands clasped in a fist bump. The hand on the left is outlined in white with a subtle gradient of light blue on the palm side and three white lines indicating knuckles. The hand on the right is filled with a gradient of light blue, with the thumb and side of the index finger outlined in white where they overlap the other hand. Behind the hands is a stylized representation of a brain, the left half outlined in bright red neon and the right half in vibrant purple neon. Above the hands and brain, the words "FISTING CIENCIA" are in a simple, uppercase white font. Below them, "FISTING ONCCENCIA" is in the same style. The background is a dark, speckled purple, like a night sky with scattered light particles. A glowing blue electrical cord wraps around a light reddish-brown clenched fist that is positioned centrally, behind and slightly overlapping the stylized hands. The cord originates from behind the fist, wraps around the forearm and hand, and extends upward.
